actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA identity evidence (DNA repair up, fatty-acid/adipogenesis down) with suggestive PBRM1/SETD2 enrichment and 9p/9q loss, and no technical confounding. Cross-modal structure is weak-to-modest with near-zero fused silhouettes, but no positive evidence supports a structural revision, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation with residual structural uncertainty.

C0002 has coherent RNA (MYC-target-low) and CNV (low FGA, chr14q loss depletion) identity evidence with modest cross-modal stability. A significant tissue_source_site:BP association is a concerning competing explanation, but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with this caveat for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong coherent identity evidence: immune/inflammatory RNA upregulation with striking BAP1 enrichment and PBRM1 depletion, and no technical confounding. Cross-modal coherence is weaker and largely WXS-driven, but no positive structural evidence supports a revision, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has coherent identity evidence from strong VHL/PBRM1 depletion and distinct copy-number features, with no technical confounding. Cross-modal coherence is essentially WXS-driven with weak other-modality support, but no positive structural evidence supports a revision, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 has coherent metabolic RNA upregulation (fatty acid, peroxisome, xenobiotic) with DST enrichment and no technical confounding. Cross-modal coherence is weak with several zero-support patients, but no positive structural evidence supports a revision, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0006 has coherent identity evidence from universal VHL mutation with PBRM1 depletion. A significant ct_phase:NEPH association is a concerning competing explanation and cross-modal coherence is WXS-driven, but no positive structural evidence supports a revision, so it is retained with this caveat for downstream validation.
